After upgrading [[church]] for the first time you are able to fix the fence surrounding the [[graveyard]] for the first time. Doing this will add +10 {{Graveyard Rating}}. Afterwards you can build a [[build stone fence|stone fence]] for another +20 {{Graveyard Rating}}.
